description:
**Divergence**:

| Crate | `impl Default for X` blocks |
|---|---|
| jscalendar-types | 3 — `Location` (src/lib.rs:640), `Link` (:910), `Relation` (:964) |
| jscontact-types | 0 — no struct in the crate derives or implements `Default`, even `Address` and `Name` which would have a meaningful all-`None` default |

**Policy context**: workspace AGENTS.md section "Public-API construction" explicitly permits `Default` impls "where the type has no mandatory fields and the all-`None`/empty value is meaningful". The policy is permissive ('MAY be added'), not prescriptive. The divergence is therefore not a policy violation but is still a cookie-cutter consistency drift: same-shape sub-types in the two crates (`Location` in calendar vs `Address` in contact — both are 'a place where this entity is associated', both have all-optional fields) get `Default` in one and not the other.

**Caller-observable cost**: low. Callers building either sub-object incrementally write `Location::default()` for calendar and either `Address { /* every field laboriously */ }` (blocked by #[non_exhaustive] from outside the crate) or `serde_json::from_value::<Address>(json!({}))` for contact.

**Fix options**:
(a) Add `impl Default` to the analogous jscontact-types sub-types whose all-`None` is meaningful (`Address`, `Name`, `Anniversary`, etc.) — propagates the calendar idiom.
(b) Remove the 3 `impl Default` from jscalendar-types — propagates the contact idiom.

Per workspace AGENTS.md, deserialize-from-empty-JSON is the canonical construction path. Option (b) is the cleaner alignment with bd:JMAP-sgrr.27, but option (a) is the cheaper change.
title: jscalendar-types has 3 'impl Default' blocks; jscontact-types has 0 — same-shape sub-types Address (contact) and Location (calendar) get different defaultability
